newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clal Electronics Q1 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Clal Electronics Q1 net falls.

text.p: Clal Electronics Industries Ltd, a subsidiary of Clal Industries Ltd, reported the following results to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.
(in thousands of shekels except per share)

Note: The 1996 net profit includes 91.1 million shekels in net capital gains and accelerated amortisation for goodwill of 12.6 million shekels. Without these, first quarter 1996 net profit would have been 15.4 million shekels, the company said in a statement.

Clal Electronics, a holding company, attributed the decline in net profit (excluding extraordinary items) to losses at Scitex Corp and a decline in profits at Lasers, which was partly offset by higher profits at ECI Telecom and smaller losses at Mennen Medical. Also, the 1996 results included profits from Opal, which was sold at the end of 1996.

ECI Telecom contributed 26.1 million shekels to Clal's 1997 first quarter profit against 22.6 million a year earlier while Scitex made a negative contribution of 3.6 million against a positive contribution of 1.0 million.
